subject: general
question: D, E, F, G, L, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between M and N when counted from the right of M. Only two people sit between N and E when counted from the right of N. Only three people sit between M and F when counted from the right of M. D sits to the immediate left of G. Who sits third to the left of L?
solution:
Given:

D, E, F, G, L, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only two people sit between M and N when counted from the right of M.

Only two people sit between N and E when counted from the right of N.

Only three people sit between M and F when counted from the right of M.
